summary_1line: Bhima clashes with Duryodhana and his brothers while Abhimanyu and other Pandava warriors join, as Drona and Bhishma devastate the Pandava army.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima, eyes red with wrath, draws his bow and shoots three arrows into Duryodhana’s arms and chest as the two heroes face each other unmoving.
Abhimanyu stands firm like Mount Meru on his chariot while arrows from Vikarna and Durjaya strike him in the midst of a raging battlefield.
The battlefield appears as an ocean of blood with elephants like islands, horses as waves, and countless headless trunks standing amid flying arrows.
